newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Nov 15.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
FAT CATS IN 27 MILLION STG BONANZA

Fat Cat claims which have dogged the Tories look set to re-emerge as fresh allegations of bonanza pay deals for utility bosses emerged. The Guardian reported that the takeovers of six regional electricity companies last year resulted in massive pay-offs.
AMERICANS SET TO RAISE NORTHERN BID

CalEnergy, the U.S. company bidding 659 pounds stg for Northern Electric is reported to have upped its offer for the UK regional electricity provider. CalEnergy has already acquired 30 percent of the shares in Northern Electric and is now though to be willing to upgrade its present offer from 630p to 660p per share to win boardroom approval.
D-DAY FOR HOPEFULS IN JET FIGHTER BONANZA

BAe is expected to join the fray in the competition for the single biggest military acquisition programme in history as the Pentagon picks two teams to develop a new generation of fighter plane, the joint Strike Fighter (JSF). The stakes are high because the winning consortium will have a stranglehold on the industry.
REGENT PACIFIC BACKS DOWN OVER HAMBROS

Regent Pacific has admitted defeat in its attempts to induce management at Hambros to take measures to raise the bank's share price. Regent Pacific, which owns a 3 percent stake in the bank was trying to unite other major shareholders into backing a restructuring package.
